posts.title: Google is launching a one-stop Gemini agent for your work tasks
posts.summary: Announced at Google's Gemini at Work event, a "universal" Gemini agent can work across apps and devices in the background; users chat with it and assign tasks from a single interface inside the Gemini Enterprise app.

posts.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
posts.summary: Google is turning Gemini into an agent that plans and executes tasks across business apps, delegates to subagents, uses multiple AI models and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.

posts.title: Anthropic bans 'abusive or cruel behavior' toward Claude
posts.summary: Anthropic's first usage-policy overhaul in over a year targets election interference, weapons development, surveillance and high-risk health and financial uses — and prohibits "sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior" toward Claude.

posts.title: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
posts.summary: The updated policy bars repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases while still allowing ordinary frustration and criticism, and adds rules on election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software and surveillance.

posts.title: Claude can now generate animated explainer videos and live data dashboards from text prompts
posts.summary: Anthropic launched two beta features: Dashboards turns sources like BigQuery and Snowflake into live dashboards from prompts, and Motion generates animated explainer videos from text and images. Docs, Slides and Design now work on all plans, including free.

posts.title: Anthropic launches dashboard, animation tools for Claude
posts.summary: Reuters reports Anthropic has added new dashboard and animation tools to Claude as it pushes further into workplace software.

posts.title: OpenAI's math solutions aren't meeting the field's standards yet
posts.summary: TechCrunch reports OpenAI's flood of AI-generated proofs deviated from the guidelines set by the group of mathematical researchers the lab consulted.

posts.title: Some mathematicians call for OpenAI boycott after AI-generated proofs flood their field
posts.summary: The Association for Human Mathematics wants an OpenAI boycott after the company released 700+ AI-generated manuscripts at once and retracted three a day later over a sign error; Terence Tao warns mass "harvesting" of open problems could leave branches of math less fertile.

posts.title: OpenAI's revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
posts.summary: A new report says OpenAI's annualized revenue is far below the roughly $70 billion figure that had been widely reported — a gap that weighed on AI stocks on Thursday.

posts.title: AI stocks crumble on report that OpenAI’s annualized revenue is much lower than believed
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE covers the market selloff after a Financial Times report that OpenAI's annualized revenue is about $20 billion below previously circulated figures, sending shockwaves through AI-linked stocks.

posts.title: USA Today becomes the latest publisher to sue OpenAI
posts.summary: USA Today Co. and several of its local papers allege OpenAI copied "hundreds of thousands" of articles to train its models and seek more than $250 million in damages.

posts.title: USA Today sues OpenAI for copyright infringement over AI training
posts.summary: Reuters, which first reported the suit, says USA Today Co. accuses OpenAI of copyright infringement for using its journalism to train AI models.

posts.title: Manus raises more than $500 million after Meta exit
posts.summary: AI agent startup Manus has raised more than $500 million in its first round since splitting from Meta, Reuters reports.

posts.title: AI agent developer Manus raises $500M+ at reported $4B valuation
posts.summary: Boyu Capital led the round with Tencent and others participating; SiliconANGLE notes reports putting the Chinese agent startup's valuation at about $4 billion.

posts.title: Alphabet spinoff Isomorphic Labs reportedly raising funding at up to $50B valuation
posts.summary: Bloomberg reports the AI drug-discovery company is in talks for a new round at a $40 billion to $50 billion valuation; the size of the raise wasn't disclosed.

posts.title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
posts.summary: Anthropic's new OSS Scanner offers opt-in open-source projects "thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost" to surface vulnerabilities sooner.

posts.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
posts.summary: The three fired safety researchers dispute claims they mishandled sensitive information and warn in an open letter that their dismissals are chilling OpenAI's safety culture.

posts.title: Gallatin AI raises $50M in funding for its military logistics platform
posts.summary: Gallatin AI raised a $50 million Series A from 8VC, Silent Ventures and others for its military logistics software, following a $15 million seed in 2024.

posts.title: AI surveillance startup Flock Safety to cut several hundred jobs amid backlash, sources say
posts.summary: Reuters exclusive: Flock Safety, the AI surveillance startup, plans to cut several hundred jobs amid public backlash, according to sources familiar with the matter.

posts.title: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months
posts.summary: The company behind the popular LMArena leaderboard has raised $200 million led by Lightspeed and Khosla, nearly doubling its valuation to $3.1 billion, and is expanding into measuring AI model alignment issues such as lying.

rumors.title: OpenAI reportedly still targeting $70B ARR by YE while raising at $1.4T on ~$50B Sept run-rate
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @MelvinInvests cites Bloomberg that OpenAI still expects to reach ~$70B annualized revenue by end-2026 from roughly $50B at end-September, amid confusion after FT's lower figure and ongoing $30B / $1.4T fundraising talks — not confirmed by OpenAI; treat as rumor. oEmbed verified midday 9 Oct (HTTP 200).

rumors.title: Anthropic pre-IPO shares reportedly pitched near a $965B Series H valuation
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @loudchirper says a venture fund is offering pre-IPO Anthropic shares on a Series H valuation basis of about ±$965 billion, and flags lockup terms — secondhand marketing pitch, not a company announcement; treat as rumor. oEmbed verified midday 9 Oct (HTTP 200).

rumors.title: Broadcom reportedly arranging $50B+ in debt to fund OpenAI's custom chips
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @YouYouFXRESERCH relays a report that Broadcom is arranging more than $50B in financing for the custom chips it is co-developing with OpenAI, with Apollo and Blackstone among lenders in talks — no company confirmation; treat as rumor only. oEmbed re-verified midday 9 Oct (HTTP 200).

rumors.title: Anthropic ARR reportedly near $95B in some investor chatter vs OpenAI's ~$50B
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @ThematicTrader contrasts Bloomberg-aligned OpenAI ~$50B ARR with investor chatter putting Anthropic near $95B ARR — no primary filing cited; treat as rumor only. oEmbed verified midday 9 Oct (HTTP 200).
